name: button
title: Button
description: Starts an action on this page or submits a form.

when: The press changes something on this page: save, send, open a dialog.

instead.when: The press goes to another page.
The action sits inside running text.

guidance.rule: Use danger only to confirm a destructive step.
Label with a verb in sentence case: "Save changes".

builtIn: Pending and disabled states are exposed to assistive technology.
A 44px hit area under coarse pointers without changing the layout.
youProvide: An `aria-label` when the button shows only an icon.

genui.description: A button for an action on this page. Use variant primary for the one main action; danger only to confirm a destructive step. Emits press.
